Select exact IC50 activities for target CHEMBL4662. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_records and docs for provenance. Join compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Filter by target CHEMBL4662 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
